summary: Renders point sprites with color, color-map, size, rectangular offset, and distance attenuation controls for particle and point-cloud style geometry.

key_params.name: colormap
key_params.note: Texture applied to each point sprite

key_params.name: offsetleft
key_params.note: Left offset for rectangular sprite shape

key_params.name: offsetright
key_params.note: Right offset for rectangular sprite shape

key_concepts: Point Sprite MAT renders point-based geometry as camera-facing sprites, commonly from Particle SOP, DAT to SOP, or Convert SOP workflows.
Sprite color can come from material color, point color/alpha, and a color map, with color-map alpha participating in the final composite.
Final sprite size combines the pscale point attribute with constant size, sizing model, and optional distance attenuation controls.
Constant sizing is screen-space by default, while Perspective Correct sizing treats Constant Point Size as world-space width.
Color maps can use 3D or 2D texture arrays, where the W texture coordinate selects the map slice.
common_gotchas: Point sprite size is screen-space by default, so distant points may not shrink unless attenuation is configured.
The input SOP must contain point-sprite compatible points, commonly from Particle SOP, DAT to SOP, or Convert SOP workflows.
Large point sizes and dense point clouds can become fill-rate heavy.
Color-map alpha and common MAT blending/depth states determine whether sprites composite correctly.
